messages:
samir: Heads-up — scheduling a terraform apply tonight in the quiet window at 22:00 UTC for vpc/iam changes that touch cross-account trusts. Deploybot will run plan->apply. Need a manual approval step for the provider pin bump. Please ack if you can review canary at T+15m.
ashley (oncall): Ack. I'll be online during the window.
leo (deploy-bot): @channel deploybot note: queued job #8472 for terraform apply (repo: infra-networking, branch: release/2024-03) scheduled at 1761136800. Will pause for manual approval if `requires_manual: true`.
maria (eng-infra): Quick note — the tf diff includes an sts:AssumeRole policy change for account-prod->account-billing. Risk: if trust config is wrong, billing pipelines will lose access. Recommend canary on one AZ first and provider version pin to 4.52.0 during apply.
teresa (product): Flagging release notes: we should call out potential transient billing API auth errors during rollout. Ops page needs a blurb so support isn't surprised.
ian (security): I want to review the exact policy change. samir can you paste the minimal diff or the policy JSON? If we see widening of principals, we hold.
samir: pasted diff below:
```
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "billing_cross_account" {
  name = "allow-billing-read"
  role = aws_iam_role.billing_role.id
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      { Effect = "Allow", Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Resource = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-billing" }
    ]
  })
}
```
samir: The change is replacing an inline principal pattern with a specific role ARN — should narrow, not widen. I still want a quick security thumbs-up.
ian (security): Looks okay to me, principle is explicit ARN not wildcard. :thumbsup:
maria (eng-infra): Operational checklist for tonight:
- pin provider to 4.52.0 in `versions.tf`
- run `deploybot hold` if plan shows unexpected deletes
- canary apply to subnet-a only for 15m, verify billing pipeline in staging
- if errors, run manual rollback step: `git checkout tags/infra-2024-03-11 && deploybot apply --target=force`
ashley (oncall): Where do we record the rollback decision tree? Put it in the incident runbook?
maria (eng-infra): I'll add a short section under infra/runbooks/quiet-windows.md and paste steps in thread.
leo (deploy-bot): Deploybot actionables:
1) Will run `terraform plan` and post plan URL.
2) If plan contains >1 iam_role_policy change or risk = HIGH, will pause and tag `requires_manual:true`.
3) Post-apply: run `terraform state rm` on any dangling resources and notify #eng-sre.
samir: Also request: bump apply timeout to 45m for this job (IAM operations can be slow).
ashley (oncall): Approved increase to 45m.
teresa (product): I'll update release notes draft to include rollback guidance and a short blurb about potential transient auth errors.
ian (security): Add me to the post-apply verification checklist to confirm cross-account access is functioning.
maria (eng-infra): I'll push a small commit to pin provider and add a canary target: `terraform apply -target=module.vpc.subnet_a -var=canary=true` — will post plan link when ready.
samir: Thanks all. If anything unexpected shows up on the plan, tag @samir and @ashley and deploybot will hold. After canary verification at T+15m we proceed to full apply with staged az rollouts. :rocket:
leo (deploy-bot): deploybot update: job #8472 plan posted: https://deploybot/internal/plans/8472 — reviewers: @maria, @ian
ashley (oncall): Reviewing plan now.
maria (eng-infra): plan looks clean for canary, one change to billing role as above.
ashley (oncall): Can confirm canary pass (billing pipelines green). Proceeding to staged AZ rollout at T+30m.
samir: Marking thread resolved for preflight. Will open a post-apply thread if anything flows back. Good run. :white_check_mark:
